summary.text: Martha Marx is a Democratic state senator from Connecticut who has represented District 20 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a nurse by profession.

paragraphs.text: Marx lives in New London, Connecticut.
She graduated from St. Bernard's School in 1981 and earned a nursing degree from the University of Connecticut in 1985.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse.
Marx ran for the District 20 seat in 2018 and 2020, losing both times to Republican incumbent Paul Formica.
She won the seat in 2022, defeating Jerry Labriola, and was re-elected in 2024 over Shaun Mastroianni.
In the 2026 general election she faces Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate Lee Elci.

For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Aging, Appropriations, Children, Housing, Insurance and Real Estate, and Public Health committees, serving as co-chair of Housing and vice-chair of Public Health.
